components.purpose: Page header/intro area at the top of the blog index — title such as 'Blog' and optional short description, giving context before the post list.
Core of the request — 'Shows a listing of blog posts with paging,' directly fulfilling the paged list of all posts (backed by the Posts container).
Optional closing section below the post list to capture newsletter signups from engaged blog visitors — common marketer addition, not strictly required by the request.
